title: The Vertical Earth Kilometer
summary: A page set to one literal CSS kilometre tall: only a 2 cm brass cap is visible, the buried rod you never see, with a scroll-driven depth gauge as the sole proof.
mechanism: A document with height:100000cm (one real CSS kilometre, ~3.78M px); a probe element measures the browser's own metre and a scroll handler reports depth, while the rod itself is never drawn.
references: Walter De Maria, The Vertical Earth Kilometer (1977), Friedrichsplatz, Kassel
